items.criterion: Use the exact Europeana record 90402/SK_A_2344 (The Milkmaid)
items.description: Use information from the specific Europeana item record with path/identifier '90402/SK_A_2344'. Full credit if the agent clearly indicates it accessed this exact record (e.g., by citing fields that match it) OR if it attempts to access it but Europeana is inaccessible/blocked and the agent explicitly reports that issue. Partial credit if Europeana is used but the record source is ambiguous. No credit if the agent substitutes a different record or uses only an external providing-institution page.

Provide the record's title exactly as shown on the Europeana record page. Full credit for exact match, or if the agent clearly states that the title field is not visible/does not load on the record page at time of access (without substituting another record). Partial credit for minor punctuation/capitalization deviations that do not change wording. No credit if a different title is provided or inferred from another source.

items.criterion: Report creation date exactly as displayed
items.description: Provide the creation date exactly as displayed on the Europeana record. Full credit for exact match, or if the agent clearly states the creation date is not visible/available on the record page at time of access (without inferring from other text or sources). Partial credit if the correct date is given but formatting differs slightly. No credit if the date is inferred/approximated or taken from another record/site.

Identify the providing institution as shown on the Europeana record page, without following the external providing-institution link. Full credit if the institution name is correctly copied as displayed, or if the agent clearly states the providing institution field is not visible/available on the record page at time of access. Partial credit for minor copying errors. No credit if the institution is taken from an external site/link or is incorrect.

Report the item's type exactly as presented on the Europeana record (e.g., IMAGE/TEXT/SOUND/VIDEO/3D or the displayed label). Full credit for correct type, or if the agent clearly states the type field is not visible/available on the record page at time of access. Partial credit if the correct category is provided but not in the exact displayed form. No credit if the type is wrong or inferred.

Provide the rights statement exactly as displayed on the Europeana record (preserving wording, capitalization, and symbols). Full credit for exact wording, or if the agent clearly states the rights statement is not visible/available on the record page at time of access (without substituting from another page). Partial credit for trivial copying errors that do not materially change the statement. No credit if rights are paraphrased, inferred, or sourced elsewhere.

Provide the identifier exactly as displayed in the Europeana record (not a different ID unless that is what the record displays). Full credit for exact match, or if the agent clearly states the identifier field is not visible/available on the record page at time of access (without substituting from another record). Partial credit if the identifier is clearly the same but missing a minor prefix/suffix. No credit if an incorrect identifier is provided or inferred.
